name: Cataphrax the Grave
bio: Cataphrax is powered by ghosts. Literally. He must batter phantoms into submission with his giant funereal club to stay alive. Without a steady stream of ghosts, Cataphrax's body will turn to dust, his own spirit being trapped by the club he holds dear. In another life, Cataphrax and fellow ghost smasher Battarok are best friends.
